records.jp: ねえ、愛央。<CR>ちょっとだけ、私の話……聞いてくれる？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao? Can I talk to you about something...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Ao? Can I talk to you about something...?
records.en: Hey, Ao.<CR>Could you listen to me for a little while?

records.jp: ん？　もちろん。<CR>ちょっとと言わず、いくらでも
records.en_original: Hmm? Of course. You can tell me anything.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm? Of course. You can tell me anything.
records.en: Hm? Of course.<CR>Not just a little—you can talk as long as you like.

records.jp: ……ありがと
records.en_original: ...Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you.
records.en: ...Thank you.

records.jp: ……なんだか、<CR>ようやく長い戦いが終わった気がするんだ
records.en_original: It feels like...my battle is finally over.
records.en_auxiliary: It feels like...my battle is finally over.
records.en: It feels as though<CR>a long battle has finally ended.

records.jp: 長い戦い？
records.en_original: Your battle?
records.en_auxiliary: Your battle?
records.en: Your battle?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: 私が初めてリフレクターになってから、<CR>今に至るまでの……長い戦い
records.en_original: From the moment I became a Reflector, until now...it's been a long battle.
records.en_auxiliary: From the moment I became a Reflector, until now...it's been a long battle.
records.en: The long battle from when I first became a Reflector<CR>to now.

records.jp: あの時、原種をリフレクトして、<CR>一つの区切りがついた
records.en_original: I had a break after Reflecting that Sephira.
records.en_auxiliary: I had a break after Reflecting that Sephira.
records.en: When I Reflected the Sephira then,<CR>one chapter came to an end.

records.jp: ……でも、その影響で世界はおかしくなっていって……
records.en_original: But then because of that, the world turned upside down...
records.en_auxiliary: But then because of that, the world turned upside down...
records.en: But its effects threw the world out of balance...

records.jp: 結果、こうなった
records.en_original: And now here we are.
records.en_auxiliary: And now here we are.
records.en: And that's how we ended up here.

records.jp: 私が世界をおかしくしてしまった
records.en_original: I'm the one that messed up the world.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm the one that messed up the world.
records.en: I broke the world.

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: But that...
records.en_auxiliary: But that...
records.en: But...

records.jp: うん。ユズとライムが言ってくれた通り、<CR>あの決断は私だけのものじゃない
records.en_original: I know. It's like Yuzu and Lime said, that decision wasn't mine alone.
records.en_auxiliary: I know. It's like Yuzu and Lime said, that decision wasn't mine alone.
records.en: I know. As Yuzu and Lime said,<CR>that decision wasn't mine alone.

records.jp: 私やユズ、ライム……<CR>あの場にいたみんなで選んだこと
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime and myself... We all made the choice together that day.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, Lime and myself... We all made the choice together that day.
records.en: Yuzu, Lime, me...<CR>Everyone there made the choice together.

records.jp: とは言っても……<CR>やっぱり消化しきれない思いはあったんだ
records.en_original: But even so, some things still didn't sit well with me.
records.en_auxiliary: But even so, some things still didn't sit well with me.
records.en: Even so...<CR>there were feelings I still couldn't fully process.

records.jp: このまま世界が滅んでしまうとしたら、<CR>私はきっと自分を呪うだろうな……って思ってた
records.en_original: I thought I'd curse myself if the world were to end like this...
records.en_auxiliary: I thought I'd curse myself if the world were to end like this...
records.en: I thought that if the world ended like this,<CR>I would surely curse myself...

records.jp: でも、そうはならなかった
records.en_original: But the world didn't end.
records.en_auxiliary: But the world didn't end.
records.en: But that didn't happen.

records.jp: 今私たちは、希望をもって前を向いてる。<CR>可能性を信じて、新しい世界を目指してる
records.en_original: We chose to hope for a brighter future. To believe in a chance, and aim for a new world.
records.en_auxiliary: We chose to hope for a brighter future. To believe in a chance, and aim for a new world.
records.en: Now we're facing forward with hope.<CR>We believe in the possibility and are aiming for a new world.

records.jp: ……私にとって、それが何よりも救いだった
records.en_original: That was the greatest thing to happen to me...
records.en_auxiliary: That was the greatest thing to happen to me...
records.en: That was a greater salvation to me than anything.

records.jp: あの日始まった戦いが、<CR>ようやく終わった……そんな気がしたんだ
records.en_original: It feels like...the battle that started on that day is finally over.
records.en_auxiliary: It feels like...the battle that started on that day is finally over.
records.en: It feels like the battle that began that day<CR>has finally ended.

records.jp: これも全部、みんなのおかげ。<CR>みんなが、希望を手繰り寄せてくれたから
records.en_original: And it's all thanks to everyone. You all were the ones that gave me hope.
records.en_auxiliary: And it's all thanks to everyone. You all were the ones that gave me hope.
records.en: It's all thanks to everyone.<CR>You all brought hope within reach.

records.jp: それを言うなら、今があるのは<CR>日菜子さんたちが希望を未来につないでくれたからだよ
records.en_original: When you put it that way, the only reason we're all here is because you and the others hoped for the future.
records.en_auxiliary: When you put it that way, the only reason we're all here is because you and the others hoped for the future.
records.en: If we're saying that, we only have the present because<CR>Hinako-san and the others carried hope into the future.

records.jp: ほら、ライムさんも言ってたでしょ？<CR>あの日の決意があるから今があるって
records.en_original: Lime said it herself, didn't she? We're here thanks to the decision you made that day.
records.en_auxiliary: Lime said it herself, didn't she? We're here thanks to the decision you made that day.
records.en: Lime-san said it too, remember?<CR>The present exists because of the decision you made that day.

records.jp: ……ありがとう、愛央
records.en_original: Thank you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Ao.
records.en: Thank you, Ao.

records.jp: 愛央がいてくれてよかった
records.en_original: I'm glad you were with us.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad you were with us.
records.en: I'm glad you were here, Ao.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: みんなをここまで引っ張って、<CR>導いてくれたのは愛央だと思うから
records.en_original: I don't think we would have made it this far without you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think we would have made it this far without you, Ao.
records.en: Because I think you were the one<CR>who pulled everyone this far and guided us.

records.jp: ……そうかな
records.en_original: ...You think?
records.en_auxiliary: ...You think?
records.en: ...You think?

records.jp: ふふっ。愛央って自己評価低いよね
records.en_original: Hehe, you always sell yourself short.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, you always sell yourself short.
records.en: Hehe, you always sell yourself short.

records.jp: あー、うーん、それは否定できないかも……
records.en_original: Uhh, well... I guess I can't deny that.
records.en_auxiliary: Uhh, well... I guess I can't deny that.
records.en: Uhh, well... I guess I can't deny that.

records.jp: 愛央はすごいよ
records.en_original: You're amazing, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You're amazing, Ao.
records.en: You're amazing, Ao.

records.jp: 私、ちゃんとやれたかな
records.en_original: Did I...do okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Did I...do okay?
records.en: Did I...do what I needed to?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: 力に、なれたのかな
records.en_original: Was I able to help?
records.en_auxiliary: Was I able to help?
records.en: Was I able to help?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: ……そっか
records.en_original: ...Good.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Good.
records.en: I see.

records.jp: ――日菜子さん、こちらこそ……ありがとう
records.en_original: I should be the one thanking you, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: I should be the one thanking you, Hinako.
records.en: Hinako-san...I'm the one who should thank you.

records.jp: 会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you.
records.en: I want to see you.

records.jp: 愛央に会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you, Ao.
records.en: I want to see you, Ao.

records.jp: 私は、奇跡を信じる
records.en_original: I believe in miracles.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe in miracles.
records.en: I believe in miracles.
